chunks: And it is narrated from Al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهم السلام, who said:
I asked him about the sign of Laylat al-Qadr, so he said:
"Its sign is that its breeze is pleasant; if it is during cold weather, it becomes warm, and if it is during hot weather, it becomes cool and pleasant."

key_terms.لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ: the Night of Decree, a blessed night of great spiritual importance

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of Laylat al-Qadr according to the Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a sign of Laylat al-Qadr as the pleasantness of its air and its temperate quality. It indicates that the night is marked by serenity and gentleness, becoming warm in cold conditions and cool in hot conditions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2027 - It is narrated from Al-Ala from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who narrated from one of the two (Imam Al-Baqir (as) or Imam Al-Sadiq (as), peace be upon them), who said:
"I asked him about the sign of Laylatul Qadr, and Imam (as) replied:
'Its sign is that its breeze is pleasant; if it is in cold weather, it becomes warm, and if it is in hot weather, it becomes cool and pleasant.'"
